page: Microsoft Azure EC32as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECasv6 family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage. The instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach high-performance external solid-state drives to meet input/output demands. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the EC32as_v6 offers a memory-optimized hardware profile. This resource density is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources without the overhead of local NVMe drives. Appropriate workloads include memory-intensive applications, relational databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications that benefit from a dedicated CPU allocation and a large memory footprint.
